newsitem.title: USA: NIMO 610 MW N.Y. nuke nears full power.
newsitem.headline: NIMO 610 MW N.Y. nuke nears full power.

text.p: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp's 610 megawatt Nine Mile Point nuclear power unit 1 was nearing full power Wednesday on its return from a repair outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit, in Scriba, N.Y., was operating at 95 percent of capacity and "increasing power" as of early Wednesday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Nine Mile Point 1 tripped off line Nov 5 following a generator malfunction.
The adjoining 1,137 megawatt Nine Mile Point nuclear power unit 2 was operating normally at 100 percent of capacity as of early Wednesday, the NRC said.
The Nine Mile Point units are operated by Niagara Mohawk, which holds 100 percent ownership of unit 1 and 41 percent of unit 2.
